'''Nesan 23 (November 18)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|998}} - [[Min]] visits [[Egwene]] in the damane quarters. Outside, she is found by [[Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne]], who she takes to meet [[Bayle Domon]] to arrange for passage away from [[Falme]].
*{{ne|999}} - [[Halima Saranov]] arrives in [[Salidar]], and becomes secretary to [[Delana Mosalaine]].
